verified_defect: A random unexcluded fixed port does not reserve that port or establish that it is currently available. TCP was explicitly bound to that unreserved candidate.
not_proven: The log contains no contemporaneous endpoint ownership table. An exclusive incumbent is a documented possible cause, not the established owner of port 49666.
change: Request port zero for the actual TCP server and retain its socket. Check the OS-assigned port against the existing Windows TCP/UDP candidate table before UDP binding. Retain ineligible TCP reservations until selection ends. Hold both accepted sockets before starting threads.
unchanged: All actual unknown access-denial errors propagate immediately. Only EADDRINUSE/10048 bind errors may retry, within the existing total eight-attempt budget. Protocol handlers and forwarding assertions are unchanged.
windows_validation_status: Pending new-source GitHub CI; local Linux tests do not prove Windows native execution.
